event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Before the hearing began CZE 217994 took a 30% Post-Race Penalty in accordance with RRS T1(a).
facts: POL 224926 asked to withdraw the protest.
conclusions: There is no reason to refuse the request to withdraw the protest.
decision: The arbitrator on behalf of the Interntaiona Jury allows the protest to be withdrawn. CZE 217994 took a 30% Post-Race Penalty.
